curatedImages.description: Black/crimson/gold energy-officer bodysuit and long cloak in starship hangar

Dynamic red-energy artillery action on sci-fi battlefield
Selena đứng tại bàn hologram chiến thuật trên cầu chỉ huy, tay trái trong ảnh chạm sơ đồ đội tàu, tay phải trong ảnh cầm tablet; khung dọc từ đùi lên, đen/đỏ burgundy/vàng/ivory.
Selena kiểm tra cụm động cơ GEAR mở nắp trong hangar, tay gần máy chạm linh kiện và tay còn lại cầm bảng chẩn đoán hologram; suit kỹ thuật trắng-đen-burgundy, góc dọc toàn thân.
White tailored academy uniform, red pleated skirt, dark hosiery in academy courtyard

Selena seated in GEAR flight-simulator cockpit wearing ivory-white and burgundy fitted pilot suit; gloved hands hold twin controls, focused gaze toward HUD; blue instruments and cityport through canopy
Black-red fashionable short dress with boots, strolling futuristic city at sunset
Black and ruby gala gown, seated in orbital night lounge
Wine-red silk home dress and soft ivory robe, relaxed night interior

Selena walks down the steps of a futuristic shopping district at golden hour, wearing burgundy cropped jacket, ivory fitted top, short black A-line skirt, knee-high black boots, and carrying a burgundy handbag.
Selena mặc váy burgundy đỏ dáng ôm ngắn, blazer trắng và giày cao gót đen; bắt tay sĩ quan cấp cao tóc bạc tại hội nghị ngoại giao, tay kia giữ tập hồ sơ, phòng hội nghị ánh sáng ban ngày.

Dark charcoal-black fitted technical training suit with teal glowing trim and athletic armored sneakers, cropped flowing jacket; Suspended diagonally in zero-gravity training chamber, one bent leg, reaching hand, cool blue holograms; clearly dynamic not static

Plum/violet ribbed fitted short knit dress with cream long white fur-trim winter coat, maroon scarf, dark sheer hosiery, high black boots; Snowy orbital observatory with telescope and planet in sky; standing/walking, coat billowing; planned trousers were NOT in the accepted render

Sand/cream full-length fitted armoured desert flight/scout suit, russet panels and metallic protectors; dustproof gloves, rugged boots, burgundy sand cape/scarf; Striding along a dry alien canyon/outpost in dusty sunset, low forward camera; practical full coverage despite fitted silhouette

Regal ivory, midnight-navy and gold sculpted futuristic ceremonial armored bodysuit with long sweeping navy cape, high ornate heeled boots; Grand fleet hall with banners, ships and gathered personnel, elegant forward walking pose; NOT tailored trousers from the pre-render proposal

Sculpted metallic silver/black exosuit with icy cyan energy seams, shoulder/hip armour and high boots; translucent light-fins; Active prototype energy-core lab, holding a glowing blue energy sphere; cool cyan lights and holographic curves

Flowing ivory/pearl layered light ruffle holiday dress with floral/gold embroidery and semi-sheer draped sleeves; strappy high-heeled sandals and purse; Elegant bright hanging-garden space resort; one hand on balcony rail; NOT linen top and culottes from original plan

Deep navy-black one-piece practical fitted maintenance jumpsuit with red accent piping, tech straps and tool belt; work gloves, robust lace-up boots; Standing at bright crimson reactor with technical holographic controls, pointing to blue panel, engineer-worksite scenery

Selena practices a floor-based mobility and flexibility drill at a futuristic training academy, wearing a white cropped zip sports top, white fitted training leggings with mesh panels and red-gold details, white-red sneakers, and a loose white warm-up jacket. One knee folds below her while the other leg extends forward; a hand steadies her on the floor, the other reaches above her head. Training displays and equipment in the background.

Adult Selena in ivory short layered resort dress with burgundy sash, embroidered translucent cover-up, wide-brim straw hat and strapped sandals, one hand on balcony railing and another at hat, gazing out over sunlit futuristic coastal bay.

Selena wearing an ivory-white one-piece swimsuit with fine gold trim and a sheer ivory embroidered cover-up, barefoot at the shallow turquoise shoreline of a futuristic seaside resort, one hand touching burgundy hair, the other holding sunglasses.
Selena descends a grand marble staircase in a burgundy formal evening gown with gold embellishments and a flowing sheer train, holding a clutch and her skirt amid guests and a futuristic skyline.

Selena in a fitted full-length ivory-white, burgundy and gold flight suit with completely covered thighs, armored boots and gloves, carrying a helmet on the launch platform beside GEAR fighters at sunset.

Selena in a full-length fitted ivory and burgundy athletic performance suit with gold accents, extending one hand toward an orange holographic reflex target while dynamically balancing in a futuristic training arena.

Selena seated cross-legged at an orbital café, wearing a sapphire blue short fitted dress, ivory light jacket and dark heels; holding teacup and open book by panoramic futuristic city window at sunset.
